reason: E1 shows electronegativity difference rationalizes solid-solution strengthening in 3d CCAs, but does not address refractory BCC alloys or plasticity; E2 only describes a subtraction method on HfMoNbTaTiZr without reporting specific results linking Mo removal to electronegativity, lattice distortion, or plasticity. Thus, the key premises linking electronegativity to plasticity and the predicted strength–ductility trade-off lack direct cited support.
